function.name: review_model
function.description: Review (test and validate) an AI model by running a test suite against it on GitHub Actions. Returns a verdict (passed / failed / error) with failed cases, or state queued/running plus a run_id if it is not finished within wait_seconds; then call get_review with that run_id.

model.description: Model to review: an Ollama tag like 'qwen2.5:0.5b', 'hf.co/<user>/<repo>:<quant>', or the model name served at `endpoint`.

backend.description: How the runner serves the model. 'ollama' pulls and serves it; 'endpoint' uses an existing OpenAI-compatible server; 'mock' tests the pipeline only.

endpoint.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL, only for backend='endpoint'.

runner.description: Runner label, or a JSON list of labels such as ["self-hosted","gpu"]. Default: the free 'ubuntu-latest' CPU runner.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the verdict before returning a run_id to poll. Default 120.

function.name: get_review
function.description: Get the state and, once finished, the verdict of a review started with review_model.

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this long for the run to finish. Default 0 (check once).

function.name: list_suites
function.description: List the test suites available for review_model.
